description_zh: Mazda3（ego）在路口右转时追尾前方停止的测试车辆（NPC），测试车辆在右转过程中处于停止状态。

source_snippets: a white Mazda3 made contact with the rear of the test vehicle

MOVEMENT PRECEDING COLLISION: MAKING RIGHT TURN (both VEH 1 and VEH 2)
